name: Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin
description: Jassi Jaisi Koi Nahin is a story of the lovable ugly duckling Jassi's journey to becoming a beautiful swan and finding her prince charming. It is the story of Jasmeet Walia - Jassi - who is an unattractive, bespectacled girl with braces and an odd style of dressing. She is naive but intelligent. Jassi faces a lot of criticism from prettier colleagues - both men and women. The show chronicles her at her workplace where she wins the hearts of her colleagues and her boss due to her warm nature. Over time she falls in love with her boss, Armaan Suri. It is the story of Jassi whose life unfolds as she struggles to make a place for herself in the vain world and unite with the man she loves.

videos.title: Jassi's Unforgettable Interview Session
videos.overview: Models and employees working in Gulmohar Fashion are shocked to see an ugly looking girl named Jasmeet Walia also known as Jassi in the fashion house. Nandu and Jassi share some light moments together and on the other side, Armaan reveals to Manchanda that he is searching for brilliant brains and not for beauty.  Armaan becomes the chairman of the company. Will Jassi get a decent job?

videos.title: Armaan Shocked to See Jassi
videos.overview: A heated argument takes place between Armaan and Mallika with regards to appointing Jasmeet as Armaan's secretary. Later, Jassi reveals her marketing strategy to increase the profits of Gulmohar Fashion House whereas Pari doesn't have any clue about Armaan's company's annual turn over. Will Jassi get a job in Gulmohar Fashion House? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Gulmohar Employees Make Fun Of Jassi
videos.overview: Jassi is happy when she comes to know about her new cabin. Jassi's cabin then goes to Pari and Jassi is shifted to the storeroom where Armaan assures her that she will soon get her cabin transformed. All the employees including Raj underestimate Jassi. Will Jassi succeed in impressing Armaan by showing her skills at work? Will Pari and Mallika create trouble for Jassi?

videos.title: Jassi Falls On The Ramp
videos.overview: All the employees of Gulmohar Fashion House are excited as it is Armaan's first Fashion show. The theme of the fashion show is Jaimala which is not available. Jassi is given the task to arrange the Jaimala. Will she succeed in arranging it? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Armaan Gives One Last Chance to Jassi
videos.overview: Jassi is not able to forget the incident that took place on the ramp with her. Mallika is furious on Armaan as he is dancing with other models Jassi's father indirectly motivates her as she is extremely upset. Armaan tries to persuade Mallika. Will Jassi gain her confidence back?

videos.title: Armaan Falls Into Trouble With a Model
videos.overview: Jassi tries to stop the model from going into Armaan's cabin as Malika has come to the office. Jassi goes to call Armaan saying it's an important meeting that he has to attend outside the office. But before Armaan comes to the reception to meet the fuming model, Pari reaches there and meets her. Will Pari tell Malika the truth?

videos.title: Jassi Gets Fired From Gulmohar
videos.overview: Jassi is in trouble due to Mallika. She is scared that she might lose her job. Malika fires Jassi from her job. Armaan gets angry with Malika because of this and they both have a fight. What will be Jassi's faith? Will she be fired from Gulmohar?

videos.title: Jassi is Excited to Go Out With Raman
videos.overview: Jassi is very excited to go out with Raman and his friend's but she has to take permission from her father. Meanwhile, Armaan goes to Malika's house and is surprised. What is the surprise? Will Jassi get permission to go out?

videos.title: A Prank Played On Jassi
videos.overview: Jassi is very upset as Raman doesn't come to pick her up. The next day as Jassi enters her office she sees a picture of Armaan and herself labelled as The Perfect Couple stuck on her door. Who has played this prank? Will Armaan see this picture?

videos.title: Jassi Tries to Hide The Prank Photo
videos.overview: All the girls make fun of Jassi during lunchtime. Pari is upset with the way Armaan treats Jassi and complains to Malika. When Jassi is out for lunch, Pari sneaks into her office to find the report and cheat on her. Will Pari succeed in stealing the report?

videos.title: Jassi Lies to Her Father
videos.overview: Jassi comes home late and gets a firing from her father as he finds out that Jassi had lied to him about her work. Next day Jassi gets ready as it's an important day for her. When Jassi leaves for work her father and Nandu follow her to see where she works. Will Jassi's father come to know the truth?

videos.title: Aryan Also Presents a Report to The Board
videos.overview: Jassi is very upset as Pari stole her report and claimed it to be her own report. Finally, the girls in the office allow Jassi to sit with them for lunch. In the board meeting, an argument takes place between Armaan and Aryan. For the first time, two reports are presented in front of the board. Whose report will the board approve?

videos.title: Marriage Proposal For Jassi
videos.overview: Jassi's aunty comes with a marriage proposal for Jassi. Jassi's mom is happy to hear about the proposal and asks Nandu to help her to convince Jassi for marriage. Jassi confronts Pari on the report stealing issue. What will Jassi's reaction be on learning about the marriage proposal? Will Pari accept to her crime?

videos.title: Boy Coming Home to See Jassi
videos.overview: Armaan has a doubt on Pari stealing the reports and not working on it herself. Jassi's family is very excited about the proposal. Pari is worried as she has to make new plans and give it to Armaan in 2 days. Will Jassi know about the boy? Will Jassi agree for marriage?

videos.title: Armaan and Malika's Horoscopes Don't Match
videos.overview: Jassi's mother is very upset with Jassi's behaviour. Jassi tells her mother about her dreams and aspirations. Malika and Arman get their horoscopes matched. Jassi also starts working on making the new plan. Will Pari steal her plan this time as well?

videos.title: Jassi's Father Goes to Gulmohar
videos.overview: Jassi and Nandu work on the financial plan throughout the night. Armaan is very angry as no one has come to the office on time. Meanwhile, Jassi sprains her leg on the way and Armaan shouts at Jassi which her father overhears on the phone and leaves for Jassi's office in anger.  What will happen when Jassi's father reaches Gulmohar?

videos.title: Armaan is Upset About The Reports
videos.overview: Angry Jassi's father reaches Gulmohar and asks for Armaan. The security guard refuses to let him in or call Armaan. Meanwhile, Armaan is angry and tells Pari about removing her and Jassi both from the job. Jassi gets scared about knowing that her father has come to the office and wants to meet Armaan. Will Jassi's father meet Armaan?

videos.title: Jassi Gets Her Job Back
videos.overview: Armaan is going through the financial report of Gulmohar when he realizes about the losses. He talks to Jassi about her plans for the company without realising that he has already fired her. Armaan offers the job back to Jassi. Will Pari be surprised knowing about Jassi's report?

videos.title: Armaan's Plan Gets Finalised
videos.overview: Jassi gets a shouting from Aryan at the reception area. Jassi tells Armaan that she saw Aryan in Armaan's office the night before. Why had Aryan come to Armaan's office? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Jassi's Tarot Card Reading Reveals Her Love
videos.overview: According to the tarot cards there is someone special in Jassi's life. Jassi denies of liking or knowing someone who likes her. Armaan discusses the plan with Raj. Jassi's mind is hovering with thoughts of her liking Armaan. Does Jassi really have feelings for Armaan?

videos.title: Nandu Gets Married
videos.overview: Jassi is surprised to see the name initials of her lover. Later her friend tells her that the initials she is looking at is wrong and her lover's name initial is N. That's when Nandu calls Jassi and gives her the news of his wedding with Jassi. Will Jassi say yes for the marriage?

videos.title: Jassi and Maria Go For a Party
videos.overview: Jassi goes to a party with Maria without informing her family. Her family is tensed as Jassi has not yet reached home. Jassi's father calls at Gulmohar and asks for Jassi and her friend tells him that she has gone out with Maria. Will Jassi stay at the party or leave for home? What will be her parent's reaction when she reaches home?

videos.title: Jassi's Father Tells Jassi to Stop Working
videos.overview: Jassi's father opens the door for her. He is very furious because she went to a party without informing him. He tells Jassi that she won't be going to the office from tomorrow. Will Jassi listen to her father? Will she go to Gulmohar again?

videos.title: Jassi Gets Her First Salary
videos.overview: Jassi's friend hands over a confidential envelope to her and makes her sign the register stating that she had received the envelope. After opening the envelope Jassi sees her first salary cheque. She buys gifts for everyone as she gets her first salary but her father is upset? Will Jassi's father forgive Jassi?

videos.title: Armaan Goes For a Vacation
videos.overview: Jassi's father comes in the morning to wake her up for work. Armaan is late to office and Jassi talks to all the clients on his behalf. Raj's Secretary tells Jassi that Raj and Armaan both have gone on a vacation along with Pari and Mallika. Will Jassi also reach the holiday destination?

videos.title: Jassi Reaches The Vacation Spot
videos.overview: Armaan scolds Malika for not informing him about the bank loan. Armaan tells Jassi to come along with him for lunch with Mr Kapoor to which Malika objects. Jassi is very insecure about the way she is looking at to top it off, Pari and Malika make her feel worse. Will Jassi attend the lunch or not?

videos.title: Jassi Gets Promoted
videos.overview: Armaan and Jassi leave for the business lunch. Armaan promotes Jassi from his secretary to his assistant. Armaan drops Jassi back to her place. Jassi gives the good news to her family. What will be Malika's reaction after she finds out about Jassi's promotion?

videos.title: Malika Comes to Know About Jassi's Promotion
videos.overview: Malika is upset with Armaan for promoting Jassi. Armaan catches Pari listening to their conversation at the door. Pari also starts questioning Armaan on Jassi's promotion. Armaan shouts at Jassi for telling everyone about her promotion. Will Armaan forgive Jassi for her mistake?

videos.title: Jassi Told to Tamper With Reports
videos.overview: Jassi informs Armaan and Raj that they have not been able to achieve the targets to which Raj and Armaan tell her to tamper with the reports and not show this information. Will Jassi listen to Armaan and tamper with the reports?

videos.title: Rumour Of Armaan Taking Jassi For Dinner
videos.overview: Armaan's parent's question Malika about their relationships. Malika tells them that Armaan's behaviour towards her has changed. Jassi is running a high fever but she continues to worry about her work. Raj gets a call from Armaan and tells him about a rumour of Armaan going for dinner with Jassi. Is Armaan really going for dinner with Jassi? What will Malika do now?

videos.title: Armaan Comes to Jassi's House
videos.overview: Armaan and Raj are discussing as to how to pacify Jassi. Meanwhile, Nandu confronts Jassi and teaches her some business tactics. Armaan sends in a letter for Jassi through Pari but she gives it to Malika. How will Malika react? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Mallika and Jassi's Gifts Interchange
videos.overview: Jassi comes back to work which pleases Armaan. Jassi's mother and father fight over a shopping list when Armaan calls them to notify that Jassi will be coming back home for the Diwali celebration. Later, Armaan's family initiate Diwali prayers in the office and settle differences between Malika and Armaan.  Just when things are settling down between the two, new trouble arises. What is the trouble?

videos.title: Gulati Hacks Jassi's Computer
videos.overview: Gulati intends to hack Jassi's computer files to know what's cooking between Jassi and Armaan. Meanwhile, Jassi and Nandu alter the passwords and file names. Maddy asks Armaan to come to the office and on the other hand, Pari, as usual, confuses Jassi as she wishes to barge into her cabin. Will Jassi fall into Pari's trap?

videos.title: Jassi Blamed For Being Irresponsible
videos.overview: Jassi's computer gets spoilt. Armaan gets angry with her when Pari intrudes, telling them that the engineer is on his way. Jassi rushes to him and tries to get her computer set right. Meanwhile, Gulati surprises Aryan with the news of fooling Jassi in order to chalk out some secret data from her system.

videos.title: Jassi's Computer is Fixed
videos.overview: Everyone in the office accuses Jassi of being irresponsible. Jassi's colleagues get their heads together to find a solution to her problem. The board members are busy having lunch and meanwhile, Jassi and her colleagues get the computer fixed. She notifies Armaan about this and he quickly comes to the technical room.

videos.title: Armaan Wants Jassi to Take Charge
videos.overview: Jassi manages to take the printouts in time to save the meeting from being cancelled. Gulati scolds the engineer for being so negligent towards their plan. Meanwhile, Armaan tells Jassi to give the presentation in front of the board members. She is scared at first but boldly manages every condition in the board meeting.

videos.title: Armaan Nominates Jassi
videos.overview: Gulati is asked to leave Gulmohar. Armaan fumes in anger on seeing him in the office and asks him to leave. At Gulmohar, Armaan familiarizes everyone about Gulati's intentions and nominates Jassi for the Vice President's position. This stimulates Aryan and Malika and they show reluctance towards Armaan's decision. What will be Jassi's fate?

videos.title: Jassi Gets Ready For Cocktail Party
videos.overview: Maddy insults Jassi in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Armaan and Raj discuss buying cheap fabrics for economic benefits. Jassi objects in between and suggests some other options keeping in mind Gulmohar's reputation. Armaan tells Raj that Jassi will accompany them to the cocktail party which worries him.

videos.title: Armaan Signs a Deal
videos.overview: Armaan and Raj are shocked to see Jassi's avatar. Moments later, they reach the venue and are warmly welcomed by the host. A lady catches Armaan's attention and he drools over her beauty. Meanwhile, Pari reaches Aryan's office for a private meeting and on the other end  Armaan, Jassi, and Raj sign a deal with Shehnaaz and buy good quality fabrics from her company.

videos.title: Balwant Loses His Job
videos.overview: Balwant drives everyone crazy at home. Nandu offers to help but Balwant shunts him away. Meanwhile, Armaan makes plans with Mandira unaware that Mallika is already there at his apartment. Moments later, Balwant angrily informs his mother and wife about losing his job. Its a tough time for Jassi's family.

videos.title: Jassi : The New Signatory
videos.overview: Jassi makes a sweet dish in the morning for Guru Purab when she realizes she is late for work. She rushes to the office unaware about the tension going on in her house. In the office, Armaan informs Raj that Jassi will be the authorized signatory. Later, she accompanies Armaan to the bank where he introduces Jassi to the bank manager as a replacement signatory for Gulati.

videos.title: Shantanu Meets Jassi
videos.overview: Mallika scolds Armaan for going to the bank with Jassi. Armaan, in order to pacify her, organizes lunch and asks Pari to take care of the arrangements. Pari is shocked to see Shantanu and Jassi going for lunch together. Maddy and Mallika are busy choosing a model for their collection when Armaan suggests Mandira's name.

videos.title: Nandu Tells Jassi About Balwant
videos.overview: Jassi meets Shantanu in a restaurant and is shocked when he asks her to work for his company and manipulate Armaan's company.  Meanwhile, Armaan, Raj, and Jassi plan their budget unaware about Jassi's tensions. Nandu adds more tension in Jassi's casket by informing her about her father losing his job. How will Jassi handle all this?

videos.title: Pari and Aryan's Secret Meeting
videos.overview: Balwant calms Jassi informing her that he is planning some business ideas with Nandu. Aryan shows up at Pari's house which shocks her. He comes to know about Pari's economic conditions and makes her uncomfortable. She informs him about Shantanu and Jassi meeting. On the other hand, Jassi tells Nandu about Shantanu's deal.

videos.title: Armaan Signs a Deal With Lavanya
videos.overview: Pari and Maria fight over Raj. Meanwhile, Gulati shows up at Shantanu's office to draw some information from his mouth regarding Gulmohar. Jassi is lost in thoughts when Armaan interrupts her asking her to fix a meeting with the clients. He questions her again on discovering her behaviour. She notifies him about Shantanu lessening the budget by ten per cent. What will Armaan do now?

videos.title: Jassi is Lost In a Dream World
videos.overview: Armaan is grateful to Jassi for making the deal possible with Lavanya. Meanwhile, Shantanu calls her to inform about her first commission check and she freaks out. Later, her colleagues tease her with Armaan's name not realizing she is already in thoughts about how she will spend fifteen lakh rupees. She dreams about gifting her father a company, treating her friends in an expensive hotel and travelling the world with her mother. Will Jassi fulfil her dreams?

videos.title: Balwant Finds Out About Jassi's Deal
videos.overview: Gulati gossips about Jassi and Shantanu's deal with Aryan. They also record Shantanu's call where he mentions that they'll pay thirty lakhs to Jassi. Meanwhile, Jassi's father catches her talking to Shantanu about her commission money and assumes that Jassi is doing something wrong. How will Jassi's father react to this?

videos.title: Jassi Notifies Armaan About Shantanu's Offer
videos.overview: Aryan reaches Gulmohar to reveal the truth about Jassi. But before he can tell Armaan and the board about Jassi's doing, she notifies him beforehand about Shantanu's offer. During the meeting, Aryan tries his best to prove his point against Jassi but his plan backfires as Jassi has already proved her loyalty.

videos.title: New Company In Jassi's Name
videos.overview: Armaan shows his trust in Jassi and her honesty and increases her salary from eight thousand to straight twenty thousand.  Armaan also orders her to help him in opening a new company. Mallika, on the other hand, complains to Armaan's father about giving the whole office responsibility to Jassi. She influences Armaan's parents opposite Jassi. Jassi comes back home and shares the good news with her family.

videos.title: Vasundhara Supervises Gulmohar's Promotions
videos.overview: Jassi is shocked to hear Armaan's idea of opening a new company and that too in her name. Meanwhile, Mallika calls Vasundhara Rao for Gulmohar's upcoming fashion show promotion work. Vasundhara shows up at Gulmohar for inspection and warns Armaan about the press.

videos.title: Jassi Gets a New Cabin
videos.overview: Gulmohar is gearing up for the fashion show. Amidst such chaos, Armaan shifts Jassi to a new cabin. Maddy is uninformed about the low-quality fabrics that have been used. Are Jassi, Armaan and Raj taking the right decision of not informing Maddy?

videos.title: Armaan is Very Nervous
videos.overview: Armaan is worried as he is taking a big risk by using low-quality fabrics. Vasundhara introduces him to Alan, the international designer. Meanwhile, Jassi and Raj manipulate Maddy and distract him from checking his designs before the fashion show. Will Maddy find out?

videos.title: Maddy Gets Fired
videos.overview: Armaan asks Maddy to leave the company. Maddy demands an explanation for the low-quality fabrics. Mallika bashes Jassi and blames her for manipulating Armaan. Vasundhara asks Armaan to apologize to Maddy if he wants to save Gulmohar's reputation. Will Armaan apologize?

videos.title: Armaan Apologises to Maddy
videos.overview: Jassi goes to a resto-bar with her colleagues to celebrate the success of the fashion show. Coincidently, Armaan reaches the same place searching for Maddy. Meanwhile, Viru mixes alcohol in everyone's drinks. Jassi's father is worried as she is late. Will Jassi's father find out about the party?

videos.title: Armaan and Maddy Keep Conditions
videos.overview: Maddy accepts Armaan's apology, tossing over a bet and keeps his conditions in front of him. Armaan, on the other hand, also keeps his conditions before Maddy in case he wins the bet. He also pacifies Mallika and convinces her to come back to Gulmohar. Will Mallika come back?

videos.title: Jassi : The Temporary Chairman
videos.overview: Jassi apologizes to her father for drinking in the bar. Armaan and Mallika confess to Armaan's parents that they are planning to tie the knot post the Hong Kong trip. Armaan tells Jassi that in his absence she'll be the temporary Chairman. Will Jassi take up the opportunity?

videos.title: Armaan Leaves For Hong Kong
videos.overview: Armaan informs everyone about Jassi being temporary in charge of the whole office in his absence. This news does not go down too well with anyone except Raj. Jassi, on the other hand, is very nervous as she has got a huge responsibility on her shoulders. Will she manage it?

videos.title: Aryan Seems Curious
videos.overview: Bindiya and Maria get into an argument with Pari for coming late to the office. Pari asks Manchanda to deduct Bindiya's salary but Jassi crops in as their saviour and warns Pari to stick to her own business. She also completes the formalities required to register a new firm and takes Nandu's help in this.

videos.title: Sales Reports are Negative
videos.overview: Jassi goes to the bank to meet the manager and is shocked to see the sales reports. The sales reports are not up to the mark as what she and Armaan had planned. Meanwhile, Aryan shows up in Jassi's office and expresses his desire to see the sales reports.

videos.title: Tough Time For Gulmohar
videos.overview: Jassi informs Armaan about the sales reports and asks him to come back as soon as possible. Pari calls Aryan and informs him about Armaan coming back to India. Meanwhile, Armaan and Raj come to the office and are tensed to see the sales reports. Will Jassi help save Gulmohar in time?

videos.title: Nandu Smells Something Fishy
videos.overview: Armaan decides to take a loan from Jassi's new company Kohinoor. He also realizes that Maddy has quit the job again and somehow manages to convince Maddy to come back to the office. Nandu, on the other hand, smells something fishy about Armaan's plans.

videos.title: Maria Loses Her Job
videos.overview: Maria in order to make Pari jealous tries to get close to Raj. Raj fumes in anger due to all this and asks Maria to leave the job. Maddy pacifies Pari and Jassi handles Maria. Meanwhile, Armaan and Jassi are finding solutions to their budget problems to maintain their goodwill in the market. Will they succeed in that?

videos.title: Raj Ditches Pari and Maria
videos.overview: Jassi tries her luck in convincing Armaan for not firing Maria. Armaan, on the other hand, makes Raj understand asking him to apologize to Pari to prevent her from going to Aryan for sympathy. Will Raj listen to Armaan?

videos.title: Viru Saves The Day
videos.overview: Manchanda takes Maria to a resto-bar when Viru comes in time to save Maria. Armaan invites a friend for dinner in his cabin and asks Jassi not to come out from her cabin. He leaves the office in the night and forgets about Jassi. The whole night Jassi stays in the office and her father fumes in anger waiting for her in the house.

videos.title: Gurinder Meets Jassi
videos.overview: Armaan feels guilty for making Jassi stay in the office for the whole night. Gurinder is busy working out when Jassi mistakes him to be a stranger barging in her house. He, on the other hand, gets a shock to see Jassi.

videos.title: Manchanda's Day Out
videos.overview: Jassi and her colleagues complain against Manchanda. Armaan directly talks to him and he acts innocent. Pari doesn't quit and informs Raj about Aryan coming to her rescue. Gurinder opts to stay at home and wait for Jassi but she does not want to go for the wedding function with him.

videos.title: Mallika is Back
videos.overview: Mallika is back from Hong Kong. Armaan orders Jassi not to reveal about the sales reports to Mallika. But Maddy tells this to Mallika and she fumes in anger. She questions Armaan and commands to meet him and Raj in the conference room.

videos.title: Mallika Takes Charge
videos.overview: Mallika wants Maddy to design a new collection. She scolds Armaan for being so careless towards his company and taking undue advantage of his position. How will Armaan tackle this?

videos.title: Bindiya is Out Of Control
videos.overview: Armaan is not able to tackle such a big loss. All the buyers are giving back the products to Gulmohar as there are no sales that are happening. Later, Leena comes to Gulmohar for a modelling assignment. Bindiya notices her and fumes in anger. Why does Bindiya get angry?

videos.title: Kohinoor to Save Gulmohar
videos.overview: Mallika fights with Armaan as she feels he takes her for granted. Pari, on the other hand, is upset because of Raj. Armaan and Jassi make new sales plans. Bindiya is still upset as Leena got the job in Gulmohar. Will Armaan and Jassi succeed in making new plans for Gulmohar?

videos.title: Gulmohar Collection Failed
videos.overview: Nandu stops Jassi from supporting Armaan. Mallika is all set and looking forward to her marriage with Armaan but he upsets her every time. Bindiya and her girl gang are up to some mischief in the office to bring Reshma down. Maddy and Raj also enter into a heated argument pertaining to Maddy's new collection. What will the fate of Gulmohar be? Watch this episode to know more.

videos.title: Aryan's Uninformed Visit to Gulmohar
videos.overview: Aryan shows up at Gulmohar without informing anyone. Jassi tries to inform Armaan about Aryan's presence but he ignores her call. When he sees Aryan in the conference hall, he fumes in anger and insults him in every possible way but Aryan is no less as he, on the other hand, blasts at Armaan asking him about the sales reports.

videos.title: Jassi's Friends Hatch a Plan
videos.overview: Mr Walia volunteers to help out Jassi and Nandu as an accountant and also help out at home. Meanwhile, Jassi's friend predicts her future is going to be bleak. How will Jassi tackle this situation? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Balwant Feels Armaan Went Against The Law
videos.overview: Nandu tells Jassi's father Balwant, that Armaan had taken a loan of 10 lakhs from Kohinoor. Balwant, on the other hand, feels that Armaan went against the law. How will Jassi react to this? Watch this episode to know.

videos.title: Raj Flies to Bangkok
videos.overview: Jassi suggests Armaan to consult with Mallika and Maddy before deciding on any supplier. Raj, on the other hand, flies to Bangkok to book the deal but Armaan lies to Mallika and Maddy that Raj is in Singapore to meet the supplier. Meanwhile, Maddy reminds Armaan to dress up like a girl to his party as per their bet. What will Armaan do?

videos.title: Suppliers From Bangkok
videos.overview: Jassi is looking for some good suppliers and comes across one such supplier who is ready to go by their demands but somehow Jassi feels that this supplier is spooky and is misleading them as he is exporting Chinese Silk from Bangkok. Is Jassi on the right track?

videos.title: Bank Rejects Armaan's Loan Proposal
videos.overview: Jassi discusses their supplier-deal with Nandu. Nandu asks Jassi to stop Armaan from finalizing the deal with the Bangkok suppliers. Jassi informs Armaan that the bank has rejected their loan proposal. Armaan gets hassled up and reaches the bank. Will he get the approval?

videos.title: Armaan Dresses As a Lady Bird
videos.overview: Maddy eagerly waits for his party and his awaited bet with Armaan. He brings a girly outfit for Armaan, asking him to wear that dress at his party as Armaan lost the bet. Armaan asks Jassi about cross-dressing which shocks her. At the party, Maddy leaves no chances to insult Armaan. How will Armaan deal with this?

videos.title: Armaan is Miss Hawa Hawai
videos.overview: Armaan goes to Maddy's party dressed as a girl. There, a photographer clicks his photos and he urges to leave. Maddy forces Armaan to dance with him in the party and tells him that his screen name is Miss Hawa Hawai. How will Arman react to the insult?

videos.title: Armaan, a Damsel In Distress
videos.overview: Jassi realizes that a ladylike figure running behind her taxi is none other than Armaan himself.  She rescues him and escorts him to Gulmohar. But trouble strikes back again and Jassi is left with no choice but to let Armaan tag along with her to her house. Will Armaan get caught at Jassi's house.

videos.title: Jassi Hides Armaan In Her House

Later, in the court, Mallika stands face-to-face with Jessica and speaks in awe of Jassi. Jessica Bedi fights for herself and fights Mallika and Mr. Thukral back.

videos.overview: Jessica objects Mr. Thukral's accusations. She asks for permission to defend herself and the court agrees. She cross questions Mallika which makes Mallika nervous. She reveals the truth to everybody and discloses her true identity.

videos.title: Indra Meets Jassi
videos.overview: Indra meets Jassi in the jail and urges to know the full story. She promises to help her prove her identity to everyone. Purab leaves for Mauritius in search of any evidence that will help prove Jessica's identity. Later, in the court, Indra fights the case on behalf of Jassi and proceeds with her interrogations.

videos.title: Jessica is Jassi
videos.overview: Indra is fighting hard to help Jassi. Jessica comes to the court in her Jassi attire. Raj helps Jassi prove everyone wrong. Later, Armaan rushes in with the strong evidence. Jassi urf Jessica now, is proved innocent.
